occurrences.text: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
